_portal: portal.html RENDERS THIS FILE, so recording a reading against it changes the page the reading was taken from. Readings are taken on the build immediately before the entry is written; chasing the fixed point would not terminate, and what differs between the two builds is table text, altering no rule the three gates apply. KNOWN GAP: portal.html is a pageTarget of those gates but is NOT in their `inputs`, so editing it does not age its own cells. That is deliberate and it is a compromise. `inputs` is per GATE, not per cell -- kitchen-sink.html already ages the templates' cells -- so adding a page regenerated on every verify would mark every browser cell stale on every build, including cells it has nothing to do with. The narrower fix is per-cell inputs, which is a redesign of the registry and a separate decision.
